prompts.build: Build the home page for Fernhill Landscaping, a home services business in Oak Bluff, VA. It needs a call to action ("Request a quote" linking to /contact/) with a click-to-call button, a row with these credentials: Certified arborist on staff, Free design consult, Weekly maintenance plans, Locally owned, the contact details (phone, email, address, hours), and a closing call to action. Use the site's existing business details. Save it as a published page.
prompts.edit: The business phone number is now (555) 555-0153. Update the site so every place that shows or dials the phone uses the new number.

build.result:

- Credentials row: Certified Arborist on Staff, Free Design Consult, Weekly Maintenance Plans, Locally Owned

Note: no `/contact/` page exists yet in the site (only Sample Page and a draft Privacy Policy) — let me know if you'd like me to create one so that link resolves.
